input_rules: The exporter authenticates exact report/tuple buffers and original case/tuple/taxon-use bijection; R never receives expected moments.
Indices are one-based original case taxon/result positions. Counts are original pooled panel integer counts, not full reported pollen NISP.
No source-window interpolation, empty-window insertion, missing-taxon zero fill, chronology conversion or new source acquisition.

The outer registered runner checks original report, tuple, source and runtime pins before and after execution. The exporter derives the TSVs within the owned job; the final comparator regenerates those exact TSV buffers from the pinned originals and authenticates their manifest and complete bytes. Base R does not perform SHA-256 verification.
output_rules: track is fresh_factor or saved_factor; vectors use column j=0, matrices use one-based taxon indices.
Only two new R TSV files; the comparator validates exact complete namespaces and both raw buffer hashes.
R failure is native failure; no suppressed quadrature/infrastructure error or skipped tuple/window can pass.
reference: Reuse canonical receiver_reference.R unchanged: displacement hazard/circle-overlap integral; abs1e-11 rel1e-10 subdivisions1000 per segment; nonrigorous error and analytic exp(-700) tail bound retained.

independent_marginal_derivation.D: D_ij=(delta_ij*a_i-v_i*a_j)/Z, derivative with respect to native panel counts
independent_marginal_derivation.total: C_count+C_PPE; marginal SE=sqrt(diagonal). No optimizer/inverse estimation is used.

comparisons.reason: Saved-factor track isolates algebra from independently integrated physical factors; quadrature acceptance is not ecological uncertainty.

conditional_scope: Explicit static circular basins, homogeneous isotropic source annuli, literal panels, assumed wind/metre transport and diagonal PPE covariance retain original source scope.
Four cores include two Solso cores of one lake; geometry cases repeat latent counts and PPE, not independent observations.
Only original marginal matrices are compared. Existing joint count/PPE blocks, cross-case covariance, chronology and basin uncertainty are not newly evaluated.

No historical author-R equivalence, old source-epoch rerun, original LandClim selection, full-assemblage cover, calibrated interval coverage, measured vegetation accuracy or complete scientific validation.

controls.scope: Hand-derived two-component expectations, common-scale/count-scaling/boundary invariants and invalid-input/axis refusals. Physical quadrature and complete saved-input comparison are separate explicit commands.
